name: fno_dino_cond
description: DINO-embedding-conditioned multi-fidelity FNO. FNO_LF predicts the LF field from PDE params; a FROZEN DINO vision foundation model (facebook/dinov2-base, 768-d; DINOv3 swap-ready once ungated) embeds the LF predicted field; FNO_HF predicts the residual (HF - LF_pred) or the HF field directly, conditioned on [pde_params, projected DINO embedding (CLS token, concat)]. Tests whether self-supervised vision features of the LF field add useful structure for HF prediction. DISTINCT from fno_additive (no learned LF feature conditioning) and fno_fire_distcond (LF uncertainty conditioning, not vision-foundation features).
paper: DINOv2 (Oquab et al. 2023, arXiv:2304.07193) / DINOv3 (Simeoni et al. 2025) self-supervised ViT features, used as a frozen LF-field featurizer for multi-fidelity field prediction.
